findings.title: Liquidated damages not the sole remedy for delay
findings.deviation: The clause does not state that liquidated damages are the sole and exclusive remedy for delays, allowing for potential additional claims.
findings.impact: AtliQ risks exposure to further damages or claims for performance delays beyond the agreed 5% cap.
findings.quote: If Vendor fails to complete a milestone by the date specified in the SOW due to causes attributable to Vendor, Lakeshore may assess liquidated damages of one-half percent (0.5%) of the affected Milestone Fee per week of delay, up to a maximum of five percent (5%) of that Milestone Fee.
findings.counterPosition: The liquidated damages provided in this Section 11 shall be the sole and exclusive remedy for any delay in performance.

findings.title: General indemnities carved out of liability cap
findings.deviation: The agreement carves out all 'indemnification obligations' from the aggregate liability cap, which includes mutual negligence and injury indemnities.
findings.impact: AtliQ faces uncapped financial exposure for third-party claims related to negligence or property damage, contrary to the 1x fees cap requirement.
findings.quote: EACH PARTY'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE UNDER THE APPLICABLE SOW IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM, EXCEPT FOR BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY, INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, OR GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT.
findings.counterPosition: All indemnification obligations, other than those related to IP infringement, must be subject to the aggregate liability cap of 1x fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim.

fine.note: Payment within 30 days of invoice receipt matches the standard.
Deliverable ownership transfers upon payment and AtliQ retains its background tools as required.
AtliQ is paid for all services performed upon termination for convenience.
Confidentiality obligations are mutual with a standard 3-year survival.
The non-solicitation clause is mutual and limited to 12 months.
The 90-day performance warranty and disclaimer of implied warranties align with the playbook.
Restrictions on offshore access to personal data and security requirements are standard.
